body.x: D&C Biotechnology (CEO Seongsu Park) announced its participation in CES 2025 at the K-Startup Pavilion from January 7 to 10.

The company specializes in diagnostic medical devices and aims to enhance efficiency, hygiene, and safety in healthcare settings. Its newly developed urine testing solution simplifies the conventional eight-step process while addressing contamination and infection risks. This innovative system has already gained traction in domestic and international healthcare industries.

Commercialized in November, the URINE CHECK-ER solution has driven early revenue through initial sales to medical institutions (11 units) and domestic dealership agreements. Furthermore, the company has secured MOUs with several Mongolian university hospitals via KOICA's ODA program and is in discussions with buyers from Singapore, Malaysia, Japan, and parts of Africa.

The URINE CHECK-ER was awarded the CES 2025 Innovation Award in the Human Security category, exemplifying market potential and societal impact. This personal diagnostic product comprises a cup-type kit, flexible optical biosensors, and an analyzer. Its compact design, straightforward assembly, and mobile connectivity empower users to conduct tests independently.

The accompanying mobile app integrates an AI-powered analysis model, delivering results that include disease detection, follow-up test recommendations, and links to nearby medical facilities. This capability supports seamless health management, particularly as telemedicine becomes more widespread.

D&C Biotechnology emphasized, "Our diagnostic devices bridge users to subsequent medical services while enabling them to monitor their health independently. This approach fosters equitable healthcare access, especially in underserved or remote areas."

The company aims to accelerate global expansion by introducing the URINE CHECK-ER at CES 2025, where it will engage with international buyers and investors. "Receiving an Innovation Award ahead of the event validates the solution’s high potential, and we anticipate a strong response from attendees," a company representative added.
